message: bend2-git5 (Git beside you): the scratch-remote push proof and the land flow are covered, at commit 896aec0298fa2ec6af01f5e1de65ab863632f74b on baton/bend2-git5 (contribution-73228162a57dabedc1fafc23dd4c1709). The push proof is a real scratch remote: native land case L init --bare a repository under .scratch, the landed target reaches it at the branch tip, and a remote moved independently makes the next push fail rather than pass as published - '.scratch/bend2/land-test' prints 'land checks: all green' (cases A-L: fast-forward, already, conflict, target move, gate block, unjudged, already-merged, ignored-build-output drop, publication). The land/review flow is the same program plus '.scratch/bend2/git-test' ('git-lane checks: all green': create branch and worktree, status, process). Built with the carried toolchain at .scratch/tool/.bend/bin/bend. push_git is a module primitive with no caller yet (the coordinator has no publish verb); that is carried forward deliberately, not landed as CLI surface. Landing is with the root: swarm.integrate refused organize for this seat. I edited no shared surface - only bend2/src/git/land.bend and bend2/tests/land.bend.
